knownLimitations: Superseded 2026-12-25 Carlo Dolci artwork ID is not carried onto the later approved Bernardo Cavallino original. The Cleveland Cavallino catalogue ID is cma-143644; 8 Dec Murillo is cma-135659.

Some catalogue IDs refer to the same physical work. Count multiple IDs as reviewable entries, NOT automatically as distinct rotating paintings; exact physical-object identifier is mandatory for published rotation.
Curated exact-subject title list is deliberately conservative. Untitled/alternate-language/event-rich paintings may still be eligible after original-object checking.
Older 2026-10-20 overlay is retained but later Oct 27 explicit feast choices override where recorded. No automatic rejection of prior user works.
Current 383-work archival catalogue is research-only: a recorded exact source SHA does not establish photo rights, original identity, phone aesthetics or publication.
Research leads from museum pages may have no image bytes acquired yet, so they are never marked usable.
Sunday source claims in the earlier 102-date matrix have NOT been verified against actual appointed Gospel texts.
All release-certified image counts in this new master are zero by design until a separate production release attestation establishes verified exact work, chosen bytes, rights, and quality.

Historic 10-date Class I registry still includes Ugolino Holy Thursday; user's later preference for Champaigne La Petite Cène must be reconciled before publishing a new hero. This master preserves historic evidence but does not silently overwrite.

Holy Thursday older 19 Oct Ugolino choice is preserved in historicalPrimaryBeforeLaterUserPreference; newer user expresses explicit preference for Champaigne La Petite Cène. Do not infer free image rights from a Louvre painting accession.
